name: Karachi Dastarkhwan
tagline: The taste of Karachi, served on one dastarkhwan.

menu.name: Chicken Broast
menu.description: Whole or half chicken, marinated in our signature spice blend and pressure-fried to golden, juicy perfection. Served with coleslaw and fries.

menu.name: Seekh Kabab
menu.description: Minced beef and lamb mixed with fresh herbs, green chillies and aromatic spices, char-grilled over live coals. Served with mint chutney and naan.

menu.name: Chicken Karahi
menu.description: Tender chicken slow-cooked in tomatoes, ginger, garlic and traditional spices in a cast-iron wok. Rich, thick gravy, best enjoyed with fresh naan.

menu.name: Beef Karahi
menu.description: Succulent beef in a bold tomato-and-spice gravy with fresh ginger and green chillies.

menu.name: Aromatic Chicken Biryani
menu.description: Long-grain basmati rice layered with spiced chicken, fried onions, saffron and whole spices. Slow-cooked dum-style for deep, fragrant flavour.

menu.name: Beef Haleem
menu.description: Slow-cooked beef and lentil stew seasoned with whole spices, garnished with crispy onions and fresh coriander.

menu.name: Zinger Burger
menu.description: Crispy spiced chicken fillet, shredded lettuce, tomato and special house sauce stacked in a toasted sesame bun.

menu.name: Beef Smash Burger
menu.description: Double smashed beef patty with caramelised onions, cheese, pickles and smoky burger sauce.

menu.name: Chicken Cheese Pizza
menu.description: Thin crust loaded with spiced chicken tikka, mozzarella, capsicum, onions and a tangy tomato base.

menu.name: Chicken Paratha Roll
menu.description: Flaky layered paratha wrapped around spiced chicken tikka, fresh onion rings, green chutney and lemon.

menu.name: Creamy Corn Soup
menu.description: Thick, velvety sweet corn soup with black pepper and chilli vinegar. A warm, comforting starter.

menu.name: Shakes & Drinks
menu.description: Fresh fruit milkshakes, chilled soft drinks, mango lassi and seasonal juices.

policies.reservations: Taken by phone or through Dastarkhwan Assistant. Every request is confirmed by staff before it is final.
policies.orders: Takeaway orders are requests until staff confirm them by phone.
policies.allergies: Guests should tell staff about any allergies. Dishes may contain nuts, dairy, gluten and egg.
